ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider / Octo Tempest helpdesk-mediated MFA-or-password reset followed by foreign interactive sign-in
ucs.description: Detects Scattered Spider's signature initial access: a help desk operator is socially engineered into resetting a target user's password or MFA factor, then the actor signs in interactively from a never-before-seen country/IP within ~60 minutes. The admin-action → cross-geo logon pivot is the highest-fidelity expression of UNC3944's tradecraft.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true earliest(_time) as ResetTime values(All_Changes.src) as AdminSrc values(All_Changes.src_user) as AdminUpn values(All_Changes.action) as ResetAction from datamodel=Change where nodename=All_Changes.Account_Management All_Changes.action IN ("modified","updated") (All_Changes.change_type="AAA" OR All_Changes.object="*MFA*" OR All_Changes.object="*password*" OR All_Changes.object="*authentication*" OR All_Changes.object="*factor*") by All_Changes.user
| rename All_Changes.user as TargetUpn
| where AdminUpn!=TargetUpn
| join type=inner TargetUpn [
    | tstats summariesonly=true earliest(_time) as LoginTime values(Authentication.src) as LoginSrc values(Authentication.src_country) as LoginCountry values(Authentication.app) as LoginApp values(Authentication.user_agent) as LoginUA from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action="success" Authentication.signature_id IN ("UserLoggedIn","Sign-in activity","user.session.start","4624") by Authentication.user
    | rename Authentication.user as TargetUpn
]
| where LoginTime>=ResetTime AND (LoginTime-ResetTime)<=3600
| eval MinutesAfterReset=round((LoginTime-ResetTime)/60,1)
| lookup user_country_baseline.csv user as TargetUpn OUTPUT countries as BaselineCountries
| where isnull(BaselineCountries) OR NOT match(BaselineCountries, LoginCountry)
| table _time TargetUpn AdminUpn AdminSrc ResetAction ResetTime LoginTime MinutesAfterReset LoginSrc LoginCountry LoginApp LoginUA BaselineCountries
| sort - LoginTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ResetWindow = 60m;
let BaselineDays = 60d;
let KnownLoc = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp between (ago(BaselineDays) .. ago(LookbackDays))
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | summarize KnownCountries = make_set(Country, 64), KnownIPs = make_set(IPAddress, 256) by AccountUpn;
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where IsInteractive == true
| where ErrorCode == 0
| where isnotempty(LastPasswordChangeTimestamp)
| where Timestamp between (LastPasswordChangeTimestamp .. LastPasswordChangeTimestamp + ResetWindow)
| join kind=leftouter KnownLoc on AccountUpn
| extend FirstFromCountry = Country !in (KnownCountries)
| extend NewIp = IPAddress !in (KnownIPs)
| where FirstFromCountry or NewIp
| project Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Country, City, UserAgent, Application,
          LastPasswordChangeTimestamp,
          MinutesAfterReset = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, LastPasswordChangeTimestamp),
          KnownCountries, FirstFromCountry, NewIp,
          RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskState, ConditionalAccessStatus
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 60m;
let BaselineDays = 60d;
let HelpdeskResets = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Category in ("UserManagement", "AuthenticationMethod")
    | where OperationName in ("Reset user password","Reset password (by admin)","Update user",
        "User registered security info","Admin registered security info",
        "Admin updated security info","Delete user authentication method",
        "Update user authentication method","Register security info","Disable Strong Authentication")
    | mv-expand TargetResources
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName))
    | extend AdminUpn = tolower(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName))
    | extend AdminIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | where isnotempty(TargetUpn) and isnotempty(AdminUpn) and AdminUpn != TargetUpn
    | project ResetTime = TimeGenerated, AdminUpn, AdminIp, TargetUpn, OperationName;
let KnownCountries = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(BaselineDays) .. ago(LookbackDays))
    | where ResultType == 0
    | extend Cty = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
    | summarize Known = make_set(Cty, 32) by Upn = tolower(UserPrincipalName);
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ResultType == 0
| where IsInteractive == true
| extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), City = tostring(LocationDetails.city)
| extend Upn = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner HelpdeskResets on $left.Upn == $right.TargetUpn
| where TimeGenerated between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + WindowMinutes)
| join kind=leftouter KnownCountries on Upn
| where Country !in (Known) or array_length(Known) == 0
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Country, City, UserAgent,
          AppDisplayName, AdminUpn, AdminIp, OperationName, ResetTime,
          MinutesAfterReset = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, ResetTime), Known,
          RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskState, ConditionalAccessStatus
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:okta @evt.name:(user.mfa.factor.reset_all OR user.mfa.factor.deactivate OR user.mfa.factor.update OR user.account.reset_password OR user.account.update_password OR user.account.unlock) @outcome.result:SUCCESS -@actor.id:00u* -@client.userAgent.rawUserAgent:(*Okta-MFA-Required-Service* OR *OktaApiClient*)

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider commodity RMM stacking — multiple commercial remote-access agents installed on one host within 24h
ucs.description: Detects UNC3944's signature persistence pattern of deploying 2+ commodity RMM tools (AnyDesk, ScreenConnect, Splashtop, Atera, Fleetdeck, Level, Pulseway, ngrok, RustDesk, etc.) on the same host in a short window so any single tool blocked by EDR/AV does not sever their access. The rotation of legitimate signed RMM binaries is a behaviour Microsoft, Mandiant and CrowdStrike have all called out as a Scattered Spider hallmark.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as FirstSeen max(_time) as LastSeen dc(Processes.process_name) as DistinctRmm values(Processes.process_name) as RmmList values(Processes.process) as CmdSamples values(Processes.user) as Users values(Processes.parent_process_name) as Parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","screenconnect.client.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.exe","splashtop.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe","srservice.exe","teamviewer.exe","tv_w32.exe","tv_x64.exe","atera_agent.exe","ateraagent.exe","aterapackagepatcher.exe","pulseway.exe","domotz.exe","fleetdeck.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe","level.exe","levelagent.exe","action1_agent.exe","meshagent.exe","rustdesk.exe","ngrok.exe","zoho-assist.exe","za_access.exe","itariandesktop.exe","syncro.installer.exe","tacticalrmm.exe") by Processes.dest _time span=24h
| rename Processes.* as *
| where DistinctRmm >= 2
| sort - FirstSeen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RMMBinaries = dynamic([
    "anydesk.exe","anydesk_msi.msi","screenconnect.client.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.exe",
    "splashtop.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe","srservice.exe","teamviewer.exe","tv_w32.exe","tv_x64.exe",
    "atera_agent.exe","ateraagent.exe","aterapackagepatcher.exe","pulseway.exe","domotz.exe",
    "fleetdeck.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe","level.exe","levelagent.exe","action1_agent.exe",
    "meshagent.exe","rustdesk.exe","ngrok.exe","zoho-assist.exe","za_access.exe",
    "itariandesktop.exe","syncro.installer.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","syncromsp.exe"
]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName in~ (RMMBinaries) or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (RMMBinaries)
| extend RmmBinary = tolower(iff(FileName in~ (RMMBinaries), FileName, InitiatingProcessFileName))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"   // exclude machine accounts
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctRmm = dcount(RmmBinary),
            RmmList = make_set(RmmBinary, 16),
            CmdSamples = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 8),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 8),
            Users = make_set(AccountName, 8)
  by DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, 24h)
| where DistinctRmm >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RMMBinaries = dynamic([
    "anydesk.exe","screenconnect.client.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.exe",
    "splashtop.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe","srservice.exe","teamviewer.exe","tv_w32.exe","tv_x64.exe",
    "atera_agent.exe","ateraagent.exe","aterapackagepatcher.exe","pulseway.exe","domotz.exe",
    "fleetdeck.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe","level.exe","levelagent.exe","action1_agent.exe",
    "meshagent.exe","rustdesk.exe","ngrok.exe","zoho-assist.exe","za_access.exe",
    "itariandesktop.exe","syncro.installer.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","syncromsp.exe"
]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| extend BinaryName = tolower(tostring(split(TargetProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where BinaryName in (RMMBinaries)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where ActorUsername !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctRmm = dcount(BinaryName),
            RmmList = make_set(BinaryName, 16),
            CmdSamples = make_set(TargetProcessCommandLine, 8),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 8),
            Users = make_set(ActorUsername, 8)
  by DvcHostname, bin(TimeGenerated, 24h)
| where DistinctRmm >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\anydesk.exe OR *\\AnyDesk.exe OR *\\ANYDESK.EXE OR *\\screenconnect.client.exe OR *\\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe OR *\\connectwisecontrol.exe OR *\\ConnectWiseControl.exe OR *\\splashtop.exe OR *\\Splashtop.exe OR *\\SplashtopStreamer.exe OR *\\srservice.exe OR *\\teamviewer.exe OR *\\TeamViewer.exe OR *\\TV_W32.exe OR *\\TV_x64.exe OR *\\AteraAgent.exe OR *\\atera_agent.exe OR *\\AteraPackagePatcher.exe OR *\\Pulseway.exe OR *\\Domotz.exe OR *\\fleetdeck.exe OR *\\fleetdeckagent.exe OR *\\level.exe OR *\\LevelAgent.exe OR *\\action1_agent.exe OR *\\MeshAgent.exe OR *\\rustdesk.exe OR *\\RustDesk.exe OR *\\ngrok.exe OR *\\zoho-assist.exe OR *\\ZA_Access.exe OR *\\ItarianDesktop.exe OR *\\Syncro.Installer.exe OR *\\tacticalrmm.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(anydesk|screenconnect\.client(?:service)?|screenconnect\.windowsclient|connectwisecontrol|splashtop(?:streamer)?|srservice|teamviewer|tv_w32|tv_x64|atera_?agent|aterapackagepatcher|pulseway|domotz|fleetdeck(?:agent)?|level(?:agent)?|action1_agent|meshagent|rustdesk|ngrok|zoho-assist|za_access|itariandesktop|syncro\.installer|tacticalrmm)\.exe$/i
| RmmTool := regex("\\\\(?<tool>[^\\\\]+\\.exe)$", field=ImageFileName, strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[count(as=Events), count(field=RmmTool, distinct=true, as=DistinctRmm), collect([RmmTool, CommandLine, UserName])])
| DistinctRmm >= 2
